central_update: The nuclear-UAP branch is now organized around a reporting-pipeline model rather than raw case counts: PHYSICAL_EVENT -> DETECTOR_OR_HUMAN -> REPORTING_RULE -> ARCHIVE -> ANALYST_COUNT. The 2024 NRC reporting requirement is a real pipeline intervention and therefore a mandatory changepoint/control for modern nuclear-site UAS counts.

what_we_get.minimum: A source-graded separation of archival fact, reporting-pipeline effect, unresolved case, statistical association and unsupported interpretation.
what_we_get.medium: A denominator- and policy-normalized residual nuclear-context association estimate.
what_we_get.strong: Prospectively defined residual structure surviving independently in at least two channels.
